body.statement: Conditioning on the covariates and coupling latent-sign connected components independently yields \(W_H(\Pi_+^n,\Pi_-^n)\le Cabn^2h^d\ell^d\) whenever \(n\ell^d\le c_0\). The proof must include all component sizes: singleton components have zero cost, a size-\(r\) component has total variation at most \(Cabr^2\) times the product of its spanning-tree edge probabilities, and the resulting spanning-tree sum is convergent uniformly in \(n\).
body.justification: Expected Hamming transport, rather than one-law total variation, is the missing object needed by central-private composite testing.
body.gap: Acharya et al. and Lalanne et al. provide general coupling-to-testing reductions but no coupling for a smooth shared-prior CATE mixture.
body.consumer: It permits a nuisance-sensitive private converse beyond the two-point total-variation barrier.
